name: apex-proposed-splits-merges
crs_note: Coordinates WGS84 lon/lat (+ LiDAR DTM elevation m). properties.gamePoints/gamePolygon = game local metres [x east, z south] from E286882.5 N5475437.5 EPSG:2955, same frame as runOverlay.ts and features.json.

properties.name: Upper Gambit
properties.basis: Split where Greenhorn's Traverse crosses (582 m from top, ~1715 m). The grooming report lists Upper and Lower Gambit separately; the traverse crossing is the only natural break on the line. POV (Oviatt 'Gambit') shows one continuous groomed run with a broad pitch break mid-way, not a marked split.

properties.name: Upper Spruce Hollow
properties.basis: Split where Greenhorn's Traverse crosses (244 m from top, ~1678 m); Dawdler 1/2 join just above (153-205 m). No POV footage.

properties.name: Upper Hang 'em High
properties.basis: Upper = ridge traverse from the summit east along the top of Wildside (gentle, ~200 m drop in 1140 m); Lower = steeper descent east of the Bob's Run junction (1140 m, ~1923 m) down past The Cut to Grandmother's (inset map labels Hang'em High at both ends).

properties.name: Lower Hang 'em High
properties.basis: Upper = ridge traverse from the summit east along the top of Wildside (gentle, ~200 m drop in 1140 m); Lower = steeper descent east of the Bob's Run junction (1140 m, ~1923 m) down past The Cut to Grandmother's (inset map labels Hang'em High at both ends).

properties.name: Wishbone
properties.currentName: Upper Wishbone (OSM: easy; game fixes to intermediate)
properties.basis: Official run list and both trail maps have a single blue 'Wishbone'. OSM splits it into Upper (green) and Lower (blue). Proposal: RUN_NAMES 'Upper Wishbone' and 'Lower Wishbone' -> 'Wishbone' (keep both members/geometry; difficulty intermediate). Lower Wishbone branches off Upper Wishbone ~235 m from its top and ends on Grandfather's.
